code: library(rxeval) library(dplyr)  form       <- system.file("extdata", "visit.xml", package = "rxeval") submission <- system.file("extdata", "visit-submission.xml", package = "rxeval")  # Which of the form's own rules does this submission break? submission_findings(form, submission) |>   as_tibble() #> # A tibble: 3 × 3 #>   path                   kind        says #>   <chr>                  <chr>       <chr> #> 1 /data/youngest_entered calculation /data/youngest_entered: holds "", but… #> 2 /data/residents        constraint  /data/residents: More than 20 reside… #> 3 /data/respondent       required    /data/respondent: required, and unan…  # Will this form mean the same thing on a tablet and in a browser? form_portability(form) |>   filter(breaks == "Collect / KoboCollect") |>   select(path, construct, suggestion) #>                     path construct            suggestion #> 1 /data/youngest_entered    last() count() of the repeat  # What does this rule do, before it goes into the spreadsheet? eval_expression("count(/data/resident[age < 18])", submission) #> [1] "1"
